By the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a proxy conflict between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], legends told of this '''Tionese king''' who had been "buried" on a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] adrift within the [[Omman system/Legends|Omman system]]. Eventually someone was able to calculate the starship's location, sending another individual to discover it.<ref name="TH">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|The Tionese Burial Ship}}</ref>
